subject: Turning an alcove into a workspace
hook: Fitted home office desks for alcoves, box rooms and awkward corners.
gbp:
Fitted home office furniture for alcoves and small spaces.

Not every home has a spare room for an office. An alcove beside a chimney breast, a box room or a corner of the landing can all become a comfortable place to work with a desk and storage made to fit.

Who it's for: people working from home part or full time, students, and anyone who needs a tidy spot for a laptop, paperwork and printer.

What's included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation to talk about how you work
- A measuring visit, with alcoves measured at several heights so the desk fits uneven walls
- Desks, shelving, drawers and cupboards designed with knee space, cable routes and lighting in mind
- An itemised quote with transparent pricing and no hidden costs
- Manufacture and assembly in our own workshop, then delivery and installation by our own team

Finishes include matt white, matt black, charcoal and oak-effect, with antique gold or matt black handles and soft-close hardware as standard.

We make home office furniture for homes in Stone and across Staffordshire. Tap Learn more to see our home office desks.
